title: Near Belmont, Vanderbilt, Music Row + Free Parking
description:
Enjoy this centrally-located condo w/ free parking. Right next to Belmont University, Vanderbilt University & Vanderbilt Hospital. Located in the Hillsborough Village neighborhood - walk to restaurants, shops, bars and live music. Only 2 miles to Downtown Broadway bars. 3 beds + blow up mattress. Dining table that seats 6, TV in the living room, outside patio area with seating for two. Each bedroom has a connecting bathroom. Near hotspots like Pancake Pantry, Fido, Barcelona & Jeni's Ice Cream.

The space
★ Located in a great area of Nashville - by Vanderbilt University & Hospital, Belmont University, Hillsborough Village, Music Row
★ Second floor unit
★ Walk to restaurants, shopping, live music
★ 2 miles to Broadway bars
★ 3 Beds + Air Mattress
★ 2 Bedrooms
★ 2 Full Size Bathrooms
★ FREE Parking in a parking lot connected to the condo building
★ High-speed WiFi
★ HD TV with Cable and all the apps you could want in the living room 
★ Washer and Dryer in the condo
★ Central AC + Heat
★ Full length mirror
★ Drip coffee maker plus coffee
★ Dining table with seating for 6
★ Keypad entry (no keys to worry about)
★ Games + Books
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Private patio area with seating for 2
★ Quiet location yet convenient access to nightlife

The space is the perfect mix of style + comfort. All aspects of the home have been thoughtfully designed with ease + convenience in mind. High-quality mattresses + bedding, tasteful elements incorporated throughout, modern amenities and plenty of space. This condo will allow you to rest and relax after an adventurous day exploring Nashville. You can’t beat this location - walking distance to so many things!
